paragraphs: Rabbi Yosi bar Abbahu, in the time of Rav Sheshet, is mentioned in [Bava Kamma 112b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Kamma.112b.8).

notes.text: In Bava Kamma, Rav Sheshet addresses Rabbi Yosi bar Abbahu. Chullin calls the father of Rav Shmuel Rabbi Abbahu. The notices attest two patronymics.
